items.title: 天文台：未來兩三小時香港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響
items.summary: 天文台發出特別天氣提示，指未來兩三小時香港廣泛地區可能受大雨影響，市民應提高警覺。 編輯：許敬軒
items.titleEn: Meteorological Station: Large areas of Hong Kong could be affected by heavy rains in the next two to three hours
items.summaryEn: The National Weather Service has issued a special weather warning that large areas of Hong Kong could be affected by heavy rains in the next two to three hours, and citizens should be more alert. Editors: Sorry to disappoint you

items.title: 油尖警區打擊違泊共發849張定額罰款通知書
items.summary: 油尖警區聯同西九龍總區交通部人員，昨日在區內打擊違例泊車，共發出849張定額罰款通知書，以及拖走六輛對交通造成嚴重阻塞的車輛，行動中拘捕一名非華裔女子及兩名本地男子，分別涉嫌「沒有第三者風險保險而使用車輛」、「駕駛時沒有駕駛執照」、「駕駛時沒有戴上認可防護頭盔」及「駕駛未有登記車輛」。 警方說，油尖警區今年首十個月共發出超過13萬8100張定額罰款通知書，以及攝錄到超過1100宗司機違例事項，希望駕駛者改善不良行為。 編輯：許敬軒
items.titleEn: A total of 849 notices of fines were issued by the Peninsular Police District to blockade
items.summaryEn: In a joint operation with the Transportation Department of the Western District of Nanyang, the Penang Police Department issued 849 notices of a fixed fine for parking violations in the area yesterday, and towed six vehicles that caused severe traffic congestion, arresting a non-Chinese woman and two local men for allegedly "using vehicles without third-party risk insurance", "Driving without a driver's license", "Not wearing a helmet when driving" and "Drivers without a driver registration". Police said that in the first 10 months of this year, the Oil Peak Police Department has issued more than 138,100 notices of fixed fines, and recorded more than 1,100 driver violations, hoping drivers will improve their behavior. Editors: Sorry to disappoint you

items.title: 天文台：預料未來數小時本港雨勢有時頗大
items.summary: 天文台發出特別天氣提示，指位於珠江口以西及香港以南海域的雨區正逐漸靠近，預料未來數小時本港雨勢有時頗大，提醒市民留意天氣變化。 編輯：許敬軒
items.titleEn: Meteorological Station: Forecast of Heavy Rainfall in Hong Kong in the coming hours
items.summaryEn: The National Weather Service has issued a special weather warning that the rainy areas to the west of Zhejiang Gate and south of Hong Kong are getting closer and are expected to experience heavy rainfall in the coming hours, warning citizens to pay attention to the climate change. Editors: Sorry to disappoint you

items.title: 國泰和快運稱使用微軟服務的旅客或無法收到航空公司電郵
items.summary: 美國微軟公司旗下微軟365多項服務大範圍故障，涉及電郵服務Outlook、人工智能助手Copilot等，影響全國多個國家或地區的政府機構、企業和個人用戶。 在本港，國泰航空、香港快運、香港航空和大灣區航空都表示，航班運作正常，但國泰和快運說，使用微軟服務例如電郵帳戶的旅客，可能無法收到航空公司發出的航班通知電郵。…
items.titleEn: Thai and Express said passengers using Microsoft services or not receiving email from airlines
items.summaryEn: Microsoft's Microsoft 365 services, including email service Outlook, AI assistant Copilot, and others, have suffered major service failures affecting government agencies, businesses, and individuals across multiple countries or regions across the country. Hong Kong, Thai Airlines, Hong Kong Express, Hong Kong Airlines and Gulf Area Airlines have all said that flights are operating normally, but Thai and Thai Express say that passengers using Microsoft services such as email accounts may not be able to receive email notifications from airlines. I'm not sure what to do.

items.title: 坪輋路貨倉火警已經救熄 消防正進行降溫及散煙
items.summary: 粉嶺坪輋路一個貨倉晚上8時許發生火警，消防至近10時將火救熄，消防人員正進行降溫及散煙行動。 消防表示，如市民受到隨風飄散的煙霧和異味影響，請關閉門窗及保持鎮定。 編輯：任順熙
items.titleEn: Firefighters have been rescued and the fireworks are cooling down and smoking
items.summaryEn: A firefighters were called to the scene at around 8 p.m. in a warehouse on the Powder Road, fire brigades were called to a fire rescue at around 10 p.m., and firefights were conducting a cooling and smoke-fighting operation. Firefighters have said that if citizens are affected by the smoke and odor of the wind, please close the windows and remain calm. Editor's note: This is the last post.

items.title: 深圳APEC｜本港下周二至周五設臨時限制飛行區 禁放無人機等
items.summary: 亞太經合組織領導人非正式會議下周三及四在深圳舉行。在本港，警務處及民航處提醒市民，為配合會議，周二凌晨零時01分至周五晚上11時59分期間設立兩個「臨時限制飛行區」。 其中，在新界北部將設立臨時限制飛行區，區內屆時將不得進行無人機、滑翔傘、飛艇、風箏、繫留氣球、放飛大量氣球。 另外，除政府飛行服務隊外，所有直升機及小型飛機不得在設立的全港臨時限制飛行區範圍內進行任何飛行活動。…
items.titleEn: APEC in Shenzhen is setting up temporary restrictions on flights and drones from Tuesday to Friday.
items.summaryEn: The meeting of the leaders of the Asia-Pacific Organization will be held in Shenzhen on Wednesday and Thursday. In Hong Kong, the Police Department and Civil Aviation Department reminded citizens to set up two "temporary flight restricted zones" between 01:01 am and 11:59 pm on Tuesday to support the meeting. In the northern part of the new border, a temporary air-restricted zone will be established, with no drones, ski umbrellas, airships, wind turbines, air-tight balloons, or large balloons being allowed to fly inside the zone. In addition, all helicopters and small aircraft, except the Government Flight Service, will not be allowed to fly within the limits of the temporary flight zone established in the entire port. I'm not sure what to do.

items.title: 早前失蹤14歲少女下午於天水圍天瑞邨被尋回
items.summary: 馬鞍山耀安邨一名失蹤的少女已被尋回。 警方表示，這名14歲少女星期三上午離開其位於耀安邨的住所後失蹤，其家人同日報案。 這名少女今日下午在天水圍天瑞邨被尋回。她沒有受傷，案件沒有可疑。 編輯：任順熙
items.titleEn: A 14-year-old girl who went missing earlier this afternoon was found dead in the rain
items.summaryEn: A missing girl has been found. Police said the 14-year-old girl was reported missing by her family on Wednesday morning after leaving her home in Yangon. The girl was found this afternoon in the sky surrounded by rain. She was not injured and the case was not suspected. Editor's note: This is the last post.

items.summary: 警方早前接報，指一名11歲男生上月21日在柴灣一間學校內懷疑被人用手襲擊，該名男童報稱受傷，送往東區醫院治理。警方表示，經初步調查，案件列「襲擊致造成身體傷害」，由東區警區刑事調查隊第一隊跟進，暫未有人被捕。…
items.titleEn: A suspected 11-year-old boy was attacked at a school in Taiwan, police raided the school and injured the victim, but no arrests have been made.
items.summaryEn: Police earlier reported that an 11-year-old boy suspected of being attacked by human hands at a school in Taiwan on 21 March was reportedly injured and sent to an Eastern District hospital for treatment. According to the police, the case was classified as "attack causing bodily harm" following a preliminary investigation by the First Criminal Investigative Team of the Eastern District Police, and no arrests have been made. I'm not sure what to do.

items.title: 證監會：已聯絡市場參與者評估業務影響 港交所確認市場有序運作
items.summary: 證監會表示，正密切注視微軟服務大規模中斷引發的情況，並已聯絡持牌機構及市場參與者，評估對業務運作的影響。證監會將繼續評估有關狀況，根據需要採取適當行動。 證監會強調，基本職能繼續正常運作，網上服務及市場監察等運作均保持正常。不過，鑑於微軟服務大規模中斷，部分通訊可能受到影響。 證監會又說，港交所已確認，香港市場有序運作。 編輯：方嘉莉
items.titleEn: Market participants have been contacted to evaluate the impact of the business, port traffic to ensure the orderly functioning of the market
items.summaryEn: The auditors said they are closely monitoring the large-scale disruption of Microsoft services and have contacted licensing agencies and market participants to assess the impact on business operations. The court will continue to assess the situation, as appropriate action is needed. The auditors stressed that basic functions continue to function normally, and that online services and market surveillance remain normal. However, due to the massive disruption of Microsoft services, some communications may be affected. The board of trustees also said that the port office has confirmed that the Hong Kong market is operating in an orderly manner. Editor's note: The following is the full text:

items.title: 金管局：銀行關鍵系統維持正常運作 密切留意微軟服務故障影響
items.summary: 金管局發言人表示，知悉微軟部分服務在全球多地發生故障，當局正密切留意相關情況及對銀行服務的潛在影響。金管局說，目前香港所有零售銀行的關鍵系統，包括存款及轉帳均維持正常運作，將繼續與銀行保持緊密溝通及監察事態發展。 金管局提醒市民提高警覺，提防騙徒利用今次事件，訛稱提供技術支援，騙取帳戶登入資料；又提醒市民切勿點擊來歷不明的超連結，或向任何人透露支付卡資料、登入密碼或一次性密碼等敏感資料。…
items.titleEn: Financial regulator: Banking key system maintains normal operation and closely monitors the impact of Microsoft service failure
items.summaryEn: A spokesman for the Financial Services Authority said that the authorities are closely monitoring the situation and the potential impact on banking services, knowing that some of Microsoft's services are failing in many parts of the world. According to the Financial Services Authority, all of Hong Kong's key retail banking systems, including deposits and bank transfers, are currently operating normally and will continue to maintain close communication with the banks and monitor developments. The FTC has warned citizens to be vigilant, prevent fraudsters from using the incident, claiming to provide technical support, cheat their account logins; and warn citizens not to click on unknown hyperlinks or reveal sensitive information such as payment card information, login passwords or one-time passwords to anyone. I'm not sure what to do.
